assumption: causal price displacement relative to recent event history adds information beyond the current raw feature vector
arms: raw plus 22 row-clock EMA displacement columns
raw plus 22 event-clock EMA displacement columns
raw plus 22 causally delayed (4096 rows) event-clock displacement columns
fit: target-specific abs(clipped target) weighted ridge; global training-only scaling; ridge 0.01 times mean weighted standardized diagonal; every tenth required row; no mask as input
sampling: seed 610103; 48 train row groups excluding own lattice300, inferred ACF120(seed2), and train0; 24 uniformly sampled valid row groups; no label stratification
evaluation: pool need_prediction AND is_scored; clip target and prediction +/-2; average target WP; report unscored-mask sensitivity and per-sequence paired deltas descriptively
falsifier: event arm fails event-specific premise if it does not exceed row-clock control by 0.002 pooled WP, or loses on either target; retain negative result
causality: all state resets at sequence boundary; current/past raw features only; prefix versus full feature parity check
provenance: explicit IDs; all valid prior-exposed; exact sampled raw-row fingerprint overlap screening is incomplete, no chain confidence interval or independent replication claim
